en: Colorized view of a European main square bordered by multi‑story historic buildings with red-tiled roofs. In the center stands an ornate monument with statues and steps, surrounded by market stalls and umbrellas. People walk around the square and early streetcars are visible. On a hill in the background there is a prominent clock tower. The caption in the sky area reads "Graz, Hauptplatz." Several shop signs are visible on the façades.
